annotations.title: Tovvard al the ſainctes.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> The Apoſtle ſticketh not to ſay, Charitie and faith in Chriſt and al his Saincts, vvhich our captious Aduerſaries count in Catholike mens ſpeaches and writings, very abſurd, feining that in al ſuch vve make no difference betvvixt the loue vve beare to Chriſt, and the loue vve owe to our neighbours: betvvixt the truſt or beleefe vve haue in God, and that which we haue in his holy Saincts. Malice and contention doth ſo blinde al Heretikes.
